# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is a large concatenation of real call-recordings, but only a modest fraction are genuine **sales** conversations (rate quotes, product enquiries, order confirmation, credit/payment negotiation). The majority of the clips are internal operations noise — loading/unloading disputes, driver/location coordination (Andarkuppam check-post, Manali New Town directions), "where is the lorry" calls, gift/Diwali hamper distribution, bill-copy/PO-tagging confusion, and app/attendance chatter. These have been excluded from the analysis below.

The genuine sales material shows **Crayon Roofing & Structures** operating as a **JSW Steel authorised distributor/direct-distribution unit** based in Manali New Town, Chennai (Andarkuppam check-post, near Sathuva/MFL, next to an "iron tank" lane — used repeatedly as a landmark for drivers and customers). The core business is **colour-coated metal roofing sheets** (JSW brands — Coloron Plus, Pragathi, Silveron Plus — plus the lower-cost Asian "Indradhanush" line), sold alongside roofing **accessories**: purlins, ridge/L-flashing, polycarbonate sheets, PUFF insulated panels, GI pipes, Tata-brand self-drilling screws, stitch screws, and welding rods/electrodes. Telecallers also do outbound cold-calls ("Do you have any requirement in roofing sheets JSW Steel sir?") to prospects and architects/project companies.

Given the volume of genuine commercial calls (40–50 distinguishable sales/negotiation conversations once duplicates and ops-noise are removed), there is enough signal for real patterns, but the sample skews toward small-quantity retail/dealer top-up orders rather than large projects — large project enquiries (e.g., the 4,000 sq.m. "Calicut" enquiry, the 8,000 sq.ft roofing site, the 10,000 sq.ft project) appear only 2–3 times.

## Products & brand ladder

- **Roofing sheets (core product) — JSW Steel, colour-coated profile sheets**
  - **Coloron Plus** — premium line. Quoted sq.m rates: ₹475+GST (0.50mm), ₹445+GST (general), ₹405+GST (0.47mm "JSW Pragathi"), ₹435+GST.
  - **Pragathi** — mid brand, thickness normally 0.47mm (does not come in 0.45mm — "Pragathi-ல வராது கலரான் மட்டும்தான் 0.5" [Pragathi doesn't come in 0.5, only Coloron does]).
  - **Silveron Plus** — another JSW sub-brand mentioned for stock/production runs.
  - **Asian "Indradhanush"** — cheaper 0.45mm alternative pitched when JSW price is resisted: "370 + GST square meter rate" vs JSW's 435–457. Agents openly admit: "front-லாம் நம்ம வராது" [no embossed brand-print comes on this cheaper sheet] — used knowingly as a down-sell when customers balk at JSW pricing or are found to have bought a rival's cheap sheet.
  - **Qualified/Coloron Plus 150 GSM "Green"** — used in a large recruitment/project enquiry (batch-number & printing confirmed per roll).
- **Thickness options:** 0.45mm, 0.47mm, 0.50mm (standard); 1mm and 1.2mm for heavier "duck sheet" industrial use (₹880+GST and ₹1,030+GST/sq.m respectively).
- **Colours:** Sky Blue, Off White/Half White (no pure "aluminium white" — only half-white stocked), Grey, Brick Red, Dark Blue, Red, White, Cream (color code 9001/9006 requests redirected to closest stocked shade).
- **Accessories:**
  - Purlins (various sizes, e.g., 25ft×32 number specs for site roofing)
  - L-flashing / ridge caps, plain sheets, profile sheets
  - Polycarbonate roofing sheet (profile-rolled in-house on their own machine)
  - PUFF insulated panels — 50mm roof panel ₹1,600+GST/sq.m
  - GI pipes (2mm thickness, "GI hard dip")
  - Tata-brand screws: hex-head/self-drilling (₹3.10+tax/pc for 1-inch), stitch screws ¾" (₹2.11+tax) and 65mm half-thread (₹5.68+tax); cladding screws 35mm (₹3.57+GST/pc, 500/box)
  - Welding rods/electrodes — Tata brand, ₹332–336/packet +tax (10kg case = 12 packets, min 5 cases); price rises 10% from the 1st of the month
  - Steel/kattukambi (reinforcement wire) — referred out to "Watson Steel" (Chennai/Coimbatore/Bangalore) since not stocked in-house

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

| Item | Rate quoted |
|---|---|
| Coloron Plus 0.50mm sheet | ₹475 + GST / sq.m |
| General roofing sheet (0.47mm) | ₹445 + GST / sq.m |
| JSW Pragathi 0.47mm | ₹405 + GST / sq.m |
| JSW roofing, per-kg basis | ₹119 + GST/kg (0.47mm), ₹117 + GST/kg (0.50mm) |
| Asian Indradhanush 0.45mm | ₹370 + GST / sq.m |
| 1mm "duck sheet" | ₹880 + GST / sq.m |
| 1.2mm sheet | ₹1,030 + GST / sq.m |
| 50mm PUFF roof panel | ₹1,600 + GST / sq.m |
| Negotiated/closed rates in live calls | ₹457, ₹453, ₹450 (customer counter, rejected), ₹370 (final agreed after Asian substitution) |
| Tata screw, 1" | ₹3.10 + tax/pc |
| Cladding screw 35mm | ₹3.57 + GST/pc |
| Stitch screw ¾" | ₹2.11 + tax/pc |
| 65mm half-thread screw | ₹5.68 + tax/pc |
| Welding rod (10kg packet) | ₹336 + tax; (12kg) ₹332 + tax; price +10% from 1st of month |
| 10ft JSW sheet example invoice | 10 sheets = ₹14,653 + GST/loading = ₹17,339 total |

**Terms observed in genuine calls:**
- Standard dealer credit: 15–40 days is common; several accounts chase 60–75 day overdue balances actively ("36 நாள் தாண்டி போயிருச்சு" / "75 நாள் ஆயிடுச்சு").
- Large project orders: company offers **up to 50% advance** acceptance, not more ("project orders-க்கு எல்லாம் allow இல்லன்ட்டாங்க... பெரிய amount-லாம் பண்ண முடியாது" — anything above ~₹1–2 lakh is treated as risk).
- Welding rod/screw small retail sales are run as **cash-and-carry**, distinct billing from sheet credit accounts.
- Loading cut-off ~6:00 PM; vehicles arriving after are told "நாளைக்கு காலைல 10 மணிக்கு" (next-day 10 AM).
- Transport/freight: customer's own vehicle preferred; if company arranges vehicle, freight is added to the bill. Local unloading charges no longer absorbed by the company for small dealer orders — customer must receive and unload themselves.
- GST is always quoted separately, on top of base sq.m/kg rate.

## Objection Playbook

- **"Rate too high vs JSW is competitor undercutting me"** — Agent pivots to the cheaper alternate brand (Asian Indradhanush) while being transparent that the embossed branding differs: "front-லாம் நம்ம வராது... JSW இந்திர தனுஷ் ரெண்டும் வந்துரும்" [the print won't be exactly JSW, but functionally the same coil-source product].
- **"Your width/measurement cheats me on sheet count"** — A long dealer argument (1.06m vs 1.10m usable width) is handled by the rep patiently walking through unit math: "நான் ஒன்னே ஒன்னே சொல்றேன் சின்ன example..." [let me explain with one small example] — reframes as "same total value, not same sheet count," and insists the quoted rate itself hasn't moved.
- **"Colour not available"** — Immediately substitute to nearest in-stock shade and disclose honestly: "Half white தான் available" / "cream-ஆ கேட்ட colour, Half white மட்டும் தான் கிடைக்கும்" — never silently ships wrong colour; always gets confirmation first.
- **"Credit extension request (2 weeks/overdue)"** — Internally escalated to credit-control; reps verify order history/risk ("பழைய ஜெயசக்தி எடுத்துருக்காரு" — checking buyer
